name: ioctl_ficlonerange
synopsis: int ioctl(int dest_fd, FICLONERANGE, struct file_clone_range *arg);
int ioctl(int dest_fd, FICLONE, int src_fd);
description: This ioctl operation allows sharing physical storage between files on supported filesystems by reflinking data ranges, which is faster than copying. It shares data from a source file to a destination file using copy-on-write, ensuring modifications remain private, and requires both files to be on the same filesystem.

parameters.name: dest_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the destination file, which must be open for writing

parameters.name: FICLONERANGE
parameters.description: The ioctl command for cloning ranges

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure containing source file details: src_fd (int), src_offset (__u64), src_length (__u64), and dest_offset (__u64)

parameters.name: FICLONE
parameters.description: The ioctl command for cloning entire files

parameters.name: src_fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the source file for the FICLONE variant

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: src_fd is not open for reading; dest_fd is not open for writing or is open for append-only writes; or the filesystem of src_fd does not support reflink
The filesystem does not support reflinking the ranges of the given files, or either file descriptor represents a device, FIFO, or socket; offsets and lengths may need to be block-aligned
One of the files is a directory and the filesystem does not support shared regions in directories
The filesystem does not support reflinking either file descriptor, or either refers to special inodes
One of the files is a swap file, which cannot share storage
dest_fd and src_fd are not on the same mounted filesystem
